latin: Vtrum sicut est dare mundum sensibilem, ita sit dare mundum intelligibilem.
translation: Whether, just as there is a sensible world to posit, so there is an intelligible world to posit.
translator: original translation, drafted 2026-09-26 by WRITER-light-batch11, from Latin at farmer1998:24508
not_established: No scholarship in the sources consulted discusses this thesis individually; text and cross-reference are from Farmer's edition alone (farmer1998:24508).
translation_note: 'dare' is the scholastic idiom for positing an entity's existence, not literally 'to give' (farmer1998:24508).
